messages:
maria: Deploybot kicked off a staged rollout (v2.2.1 -> 5%) in eu-west during our late change window. Noticing embed p95 drift. tagging @anna @sachin — can you triage? id: 1839990001

deploybot: Deploy started: v2.2.1 -> 5% (eu-west). Snapshot: embed_latency_p95 +150ms vs baseline, errors 0.35% (baseline 0.08%). Pause: `/deploy pause 1839990001`. Pin to previous: `/deploy pin --region eu-west --revision v2.1.4`. Docs: https://redwood.internal/deploys/runbook

sachin: Confirmed. p95 spike +155ms, tail ~900ms on /v1/embeds. Correlates with kvcache churn and tokenizer downstream 503 retries. Grabbing recent pod logs and kernel OOM alerts.

anna: Let's pin eu-west back to v2.1.4 and run a targeted cache-warm job. Late window concerns me; if we can't get p95 within +15ms in 10m, propose full rollback. maria, change window end?

maria: Window open for 35m. I'm leaning to pin + investigate; avoid global rollback unless necessary. Support, prep rollback comms just in case.

sachin: Logs:```bash
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embed -c model --since=10m | tail -n 60
```shows repeated `kvcache: evict` and `tokenizer: 503 retry`. Sample:
```
2026-04-02T22:10:11Z model: kvcache evict key=ctx-xyz789 size=12
2026-04-02T22:10:12Z tokenizer: upstream 503 attempt=1
2026-04-02T22:10:12Z tokenizer: upstream 503 attempt=2
```

deploybot: Pinning action: eu-west pinned to v2.1.4, canary paused (1839990001). To resume: `/deploy resume 1839990001`. Actioned by anna at 2026-04-02T22:11:05Z.

maria: Monitor next 5m. If p95 doesn't return to within +15ms, quick vote for rollback. Add note to release notes: "v2.2.1 may introduce higher embed p95 in some regions."

sachin: p95 returned to baseline within 4m after pin and cache warmup. Errors back to baseline. Kernel OOMs not present. Suggest we either abort this canary and schedule a controlled dry-run with instrumented cache warming, or retry with traffic shaping.

anna: Given late window and customer impact risk, I vote rollback global. Quick poll: +1 full rollback, 0 leave pinned, -1 try again now.

maria: Vote +1 rollback. Support, please draft a short incident message. Deploybot, initiate global rollback to v2.1.4 when ready.

deploybot: Rollback initiated: v2.2.1 -> 0%, v2.1.4 -> 100% across all regions. Rollback id rb-1839990001. Rolling updates in progress. ETA ~3m.

support: Draft posted for review: "We reverted an embedding-serving change (v2.2.1) due to a small latency regression detected during canary in eu-west. Service restored to v2.1.4; were investigating." Will publish once rollback completes.

maria: Thanks. I'll open a triage ticket, tag infra and model-onboarding. Add failing prompts and telemetry to Redwood Optimize evals. Plan: block v2.2.1 re-rollout until kvcache behavior is addressed and we have dry-run data.

deploybot: Rollback complete: rb-1839990001. All traffic on v2.1.4. Recommend scheduling a controlled dry-run in next daytime change window and include a small canary with warmed caches.
